post.summary: Accept one file for asynchronous reading
post.description: Without the provider header, PDF/XLSX/CSV are stored locally. With SPUR, submit PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, UTF-8 TXT/CSV (up to 20 MiB, 20 printed pages) or PNG/JPEG (up to 4 MiB). Unsupported types return 415; unrenderable and over-page-limit documents fail asynchronously. The file byte limit is configurable (demo default 20 MiB). New key = new operation. Same key and identical file bytes (even with a different name) = same receipt; same key and different bytes or processing mode = 409. Do not use file name or digest alone as the key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per upload action; reuse it after network loss.

parameters.name: X-OCR-Provider
parameters.description: Set for the Send to OCR action; printed pages go to SPUR. Requires the local SPUR overlay; otherwise 503/ocr_disabled. Omit for regular uploads.

get.description: Read-only. Poll Queued/Processing, including Processing → Queued on transient retry. Stop on Completed or Failed. A successful status lookup is HTTP 200 even for Failed.

post.summary: Search completed OCR indexes for page excerpts
post.description: Explicit search is read-only with respect to documents. When compatible excerpts exist, the server submits the query text to SPUR. Only currently compatible indexes from successful SPUR OCR are searched; neither originals nor search queries are persisted by this operation.

WorkspaceRequest.name: X-Workspace-Request
WorkspaceRequest.description: Same-origin intent marker. Do not enable cross-origin credentialed requests.

Receipt.description: Stable identity of the accepted operation. Query Location for its current state, including on replay.

attempt.description: Number of claims so far; zero before the first claim. It does not reset when a transient failure requeues a job.

failureCode.description: Safe terminal code from the backend resource catalog; present only in Failed. A vetted reader cause is retained when available. Older receipts may use reader_rejected. Never provider text or document content.

Locator.description: Position in the original, not in rasterized or concatenated text. Page/row/column indexes start at 1. Spreadsheet names are source data; do not translate them.

range.description: A1 cell or rectangular range in the indicated worksheet.

ReadResult.description: Technical reading, not an origin claim. Empty fragments are allowed when nothing was readable; include a located warning in that case.

failureCode.description: Safe terminal cause, present only for Failed.

query.description: Trimmed query; whitespace-only input and NUL characters are rejected.

sourceName.description: Retained for compatibility; original names are not admitted to the new index.

locator.description: Legacy display locator, such as page 1.

score.description: Cosine similarity clamped to [0, 1]; not confidence or evidence quality.

Problem.description: Safe Problem Details payload. Branch on HTTP status and code, never on title. Unknown codes must fall back to a generic message.
